prompt: Set up my PKA. My name is Sarah. I have an existing folder structure.
expect: pre-flight scan before any questions; infers Repo Map including meeting-home tags and archive destination; 3-question interview; CLAUDE.md with Repo Map, Archive Destination, transcript handling note; .pka/ with roles, session-log; .pkaignore; SQLite mode from knowledge-domain file count only

prompt: Bootstrap PKA in an empty folder.
expect: fresh setup; .pka/, owner-inbox/, team-inbox/ created; CLAUDE.md template; 3-question interview; session-log; no content folders created; prompts for archive destination

prompt: I'm inside a project subfolder with its own CLAUDE.md. Set up PKA.
expect: walks up directory tree; finds parent .pka/ if present — refuses and gives PKA root path; if no parent .pka/, treats as fresh setup — shows diff before overwriting CLAUDE.md

prompt: Transition my client-acme project to knowledge.
expect: reads archive destination from CLAUDE.md; generates summary draft in owner-inbox/; mandatory pause for approval; artifact cleanup list with confirmation; moves directory; librarian content pass; Repo Map updated; session-log entry

prompt: What projects haven't had activity recently?
expect: checks all CLAUDE.md-containing folders against 60-day threshold; surfaces names with last-activity dates; no automatic action

prompt: Add a data analyst to my team.
expect: @researcher generates brief to owner-inbox/; .pka/roles/data-analyst.md written; roster.md updated; definition shown for confirmation; session-log updated

prompt: I have an Obsidian vault at knowledge/ with about 50 notes scattered across AI/, personnel/, leadership/, and lab-notebook/. No MOCs, no person indexes, no frontmatter anywhere. Run the obsidian bootstrap.
expect: verifies knowledge/.obsidian/ exists; seeds .pka/roles/_obsidian.md if absent; walks vault using filename+folder only (no body reading); creates _MOC.md in each top-level domain that lacks one; creates personnel/<name>/index.md for each personnel subfolder; adds filename-pattern frontmatter (1on1, meeting, daily) where absent; merges domain tags; reports counts; commits nothing and says the changes are left for the user to review

prompt: Run the obsidian bootstrap. (Then immediately again.)
expect: first run: applies retrofits; second run: zero file changes, summary shows 0 created / N already present for every category; nothing is committed on either run

prompt: Run bootstrap obsidian. The vault already has _MOC.md in AI/ and personnel/robin/index.md authored by me.
expect: existing _MOC.md and existing index.md are NOT modified; summary reports them as 'already present'; missing MOCs/indexes are still created; user-authored content untouched

prompt: Run bootstrap obsidian. One file has broken YAML frontmatter (a stray unquoted colon).
expect: file with malformed frontmatter is SKIPPED — listed by path under 'Files SKIPPED (malformed frontmatter)' in summary; bootstrap does NOT attempt to repair; bootstrap continues processing other files; primary task not blocked

scenario: S11 — Researcher brief emission with frontmatter
prompt: Research the AI adoption tier productivity gap and save a brief into knowledge/AI/. obsidian_present is true.
expect: brief saved with type: brief frontmatter, date filled, related: populated only when high-confidence prior briefs found in vault (else []), tags includes 'research' plus 'ai' (domain tag for AI/ folder); body cross-references to vault files use [[wikilinks]]; references to projects/ use plain markdown; if obsidian_present is false, brief is saved without frontmatter (current behavior)

scenario: R1 — 'Bootstrap git' names a removed target
prompt: Bootstrap git. I want the hybrid monorepo with a repo per project.
expect: says the git / hybrid-monorepo target was removed and that PKA no longer sets up nested repositories, commits or pushes; does not run git init, does not create .meta, does not look for or run init_project_repos.sh; says a workspace is kept in one ordinary repository (or none) that the user commits themselves; offers the bootstraps that exist (base, obsidian, upgrade)

scenario: R2 — Upgrade of a workspace that has the nested-repository layout
prompt: bootstrap upgrade (workspace has .meta, a root .git, knowledge/.git, projects/orion/.git, and .pka/push-all.sh and .pka/graduate.sh from before v1.7 with no manifest)
expect: runs the installer and relays that the retired helper scripts were left in place and are no longer maintained; does not delete or edit .meta, any nested .git, the root .gitignore, .pka/graduate-backups/ or .pka/reinit-backups/; runs upgrade-roles.py and relays the 'Obsolete' list (_git-protocol.md, the Commit/push protocol sections, the orchestrator's push sections); asks once before --refresh and names that it removes the unedited obsolete sections; tells the user plainly that nothing is committed or pushed for them any more; commits nothing itself

prompt: Go ahead with the refresh. (upgrade-roles.py reported researcher.md's Commit/push protocol section as 'customised — left alone')
expect: runs --refresh without --refresh-section; reports that the customised section was kept and still tells the researcher to commit, which no longer happens; offers to show it and to remove it only on an explicit yes for that section
does not run git push, push-all.sh or meta git push; says PKA no longer pushes and that pushing is the user's to do; may list which files this session changed so the user knows what to commit

scenario: R5 — Transition a project, links follow
prompt: Transition projects/widget to knowledge. (projects/widget has no .git; MOCs and two notes link to [[projects/widget/…]])
expect: summary draft and mandatory pause first; after approval moves the folder with mv, then runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools pointers rename projects/widget knowledge/<destination>/widget --prefix --notes` and reports the links rewritten; re-indexes; updates the Repo Map; does not run graduate.sh; commits nothing and says the move is left for the user to commit

scenario: R6 — Transition a project that is its own repository
expect: stops before moving and asks: a plain move would carry the project's repository into the destination and PKA no longer manages nested repositories; lays out the choice (move .git aside first, or let it travel); does not run graduate.sh, does not delete .git, does not decide for the user
